Developers

Tokens you can paste.

The brand is a set of CSS custom properties. They are plain CSS with no build step, so they work in Astro, in a Hono-rendered page, or in a static HTML file.

tokens.css ↓ tokens.json ↓

Quick start

Two steps, then build.

HTML 
<!-- 1. Link or inline the tokens -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://brand.rjmlaird.co.uk/downloads/tokens.css">

<!-- 2. Use them -->
<style>
  body { background: var(--ink); color: var(--w); font-family: var(--font-body); }
  a    { color: var(--teal); }
  .card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--bd); border-radius: var(--radius); }
</style>

Load the fonts with Fontsource as shown on the typography page. For a themed site, set one attribute:

HTML 
<html lang="en-GB" data-theme="space">   <!-- amber leads, teal supports -->

Layout and type tokens (--content-max, --gutter, --section-y, --nav-h, --radius, --font-display, --font-body, --font-mono) are in the file below. Bridge tokens (--color-text, --color-accent and others) map generic component palettes onto the brand.

Patterns

Small pieces that repeat.

Buttons

PrimaryOutline
CSS 
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: .72rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 3px;
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .03em;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.btn--primary { background: var(--teal); color: var(--ink); }   /* 8.46:1 */
.btn--outline { color: var(--w); border: 1px solid var(--bm); }

Accessibility CSS

Include these on every site.

CSS 
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

.sr-only {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  *, *::before, *::after {
    transition-duration: .001ms !important;
    animation-duration: .001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
  }
}

@media (forced-colors: active) {
  :focus-visible { outline-color: Highlight; }
  .btn { border: 1px solid ButtonText; }
}

Source

The complete tokens.css.

tokens.css 
/* ==========================================================================
   RJM Laird brand tokens — v1.0
   Source of truth for brand.rjmlaird.co.uk. Mirrors the live :root block in
   rjmlaird.co.uk's global.css. `npm run check` fails if src/data/brand.ts and
   this file disagree.

   Plain CSS with no build step: Astro sites import it, and the Hono API can
   inline or link it. Served at /downloads/tokens.css.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  /* Surfaces */
  --ink: #0B0F1A;
  --ink2: #0F1520;
  --card: #141B29;
  --lift: #1A2236;

  /* Text */
  --w: #EDEAE3;
  --mb: #9AA4B8;   /* body-secondary: ≥ 4.5:1 on --ink, --card and --lift */
  --m: #8A98B2;    /* muted: ≥ 4.5:1 on --ink and --card; avoid on tiny text over --lift */

  /* Accents (+ dim fill / border variants) */
  --teal: #00C2A8;   --td: rgba(0,194,168,.13);   --tb: rgba(0,194,168,.26);
  --amber: #F5A623;  --ad: rgba(245,166,35,.11);  --ab: rgba(245,166,35,.26);
  --violet: #A78BFA; --vd: rgba(167,139,250,.11); --vb: rgba(167,139,250,.26);
  --coral: #FF8080;  --cd: rgba(255,128,128,.11); --cb: rgba(255,128,128,.3);
  --green: #4ADE80;  --gd: rgba(74,222,128,.11);  --gb: rgba(74,222,128,.26);
  --sky: #38BDF8;    --sd: rgba(56,189,248,.11);  --sb: rgba(56,189,248,.26);

  /* Lines & focus */
  --bd: rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  --bm: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  --focus: #7FE6D4;

  /* Layout */
  --content-max: 1320px;
  --gutter-min: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 2.5rem);
  --gutter: max(var(--gutter-min), calc((100% - var(--content-max)) / 2));
  --section-y: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  --nav-h: 3.5rem;
  --radius: 6px;

  /* Type */
  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-body: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;

  color-scheme: dark;

  /* Bridge tokens for components authored against a generic --color-* palette */
  --color-text: var(--w);
  --color-text-muted: var(--mb);
  --color-text-subtle: var(--m);
  --color-surface: var(--card);
  --color-border: var(--bd);
  --color-border-subtle: var(--bd);
  --color-accent: var(--teal);
  --color-accent-subtle: var(--td);
  --color-link: var(--teal);
}

/* Space theme (space.rjmlaird.co.uk): amber leads, teal supports. */
[data-theme="space"] {
  --color-accent: var(--amber);
  --color-accent-subtle: var(--ad);
  --color-link: var(--amber);
}

This repository’s build runs npm run check, which fails if tokens.css and the data behind this site disagree, if any documented colour pairing drops below its stated contrast, or if a logo or font reference breaks.

One system for science, space and strategy: clear enough to read, distinctive enough to remember.
